title: Scatterplot with marginal histograms
intent: Compare penguin flipper length and body mass while retaining the one-dimensional distribution of each measurement.

source.title: Observable Plot bin transform and rect mark

ai.create: Create a joint scatterplot of Palmer Penguins flipper length and body mass with a top histogram for flipper length and a right histogram for body mass, using the same raw observations for all three views.
ai.maintain: Change the bin boundaries while retaining complete boundary semantics, responsive shared scales, inferred fields, and separate scatter and marginal regions.
